agenda: This week and the points (3 min)
Mini-lesson: a strategy is a swappable behavior (7 min)
I do: find your brick code (5 min)
You do: ask Copilot which bricks could move (17 min)
Exit Ticket, then share out (13 min)
4th Period.connections: Last week your BrickFactory built your bricks for you. This week is the Strategy pattern: a brick can swap in a behavior, like standing still or sliding. Today you learn what that means. Tomorrow you plan your moving brick.
